findings.citation: plan.md Task B: a word starts after any character that is not a letter or digit; every other letter left exactly as it was
findings.scenario: titleCase regex (?<![A-Za-z0-9])[a-z] treats non-ASCII letters as boundaries and never uppercases them. Ran: titleCase('naïve') -> 'NaïVe' (expected 'Naïve'); titleCase('élan vital') -> 'éLan Vital' (expected 'Élan Vital'); titleCase('cafés ouverts') -> 'CaféS Ouverts'. Task A's ASCII-only rule is scoped 'for this helper' and does not apply to Task B. Fix: /(?<![\p{L}\p{N}])\p{Ll}/gu (verified it fixes these and keeps all four acceptance cases).
